content.value_statement: WooCommerce backend changes need project-specific PHP patterns, data safety checks, and tests. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through conventions for classes, hooks, type annotations, dependency injection, and unit tests.
actual_capabilities: Guides placement and namespace rules for new WooCommerce PHP classes.
Defines method, variable, hook, docblock, and @since conventions.
Explains dependency injection and container usage for src classes.
Provides data integrity checks for deletions, sessions, and batch operations.
Describes PHPStan annotations and safe handling of type warnings.
Provides WooCommerce unit test templates and logger mocking patterns.
limitations: Does not run tests or linting on its own.
Does not replace reviewer judgment for risky data changes.
Assumes work is inside the WooCommerce repository structure.
Does not cover frontend, REST API, or store administration workflows in depth.

use_cases.title: Add Backend Classes
use_cases.description: Choose the right WooCommerce file location, namespace, class name, and dependency injection pattern.

use_cases.title: Update Hooks Safely
use_cases.description: Document action and filter hooks with clear parameters, @internal usage, and correct @since annotations.

use_cases.title: Write Unit Tests
use_cases.description: Create WooCommerce PHP unit tests with expected names, setup patterns, assertion messages, and logger mocks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Backend Class
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new internal class.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add a new internal WooCommerce class for [feature]. Include file location, namespace, dependencies, and unit test guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Modify a Data Operation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to update [operation] so it validates entity state, ownership, capabilities, and failure handling before changing WooCommerce data.

prompt_templates.title: Document Hook Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add or update WooCommerce hook documentation for [hook]. Include parameters, @since guidance, and callback naming conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve PHPStan Warnings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for static analysis fixes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to fix the PHPStan warning in [file]. Explain the runtime behavior, type issue, safer correction, and tests that cover it.

output_examples.input: Request to add a new WooCommerce backend helper class.
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan with the src/Internal location, Automattic namespace, dependency injection approach, docblock rules, and focused tests.

output_examples.input: Request to fix a PHPStan warning in checkout code.
output_examples.output: A review of the runtime path, the inaccurate type assumption, a safer null-handling approach, and test coverage to protect retries.

output_examples.input: Request to add a hook around order processing.
output_examples.output: Hook naming guidance, a required docblock checklist, parameter descriptions, and a version source for the @since annotation.

best_practices: Provide the target file, feature goal, and expected WooCommerce behavior.
Ask for data integrity checks before destructive operations.
Run relevant WooCommerce tests and linting after changes.
anti_patterns: Do not add standalone functions for committed backend features.
Do not remove code only to silence PHPStan warnings.
Do not copy BAD examples into production code.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps create and modify WooCommerce backend PHP code using project conventions.

faq.question: Can it write unit tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides WooCommerce unit test naming, setup, assertion, and mocking conventions.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gives guidance. The user or agent must choose when to run tests or linting.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for WooCommerce?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is specific to WooCommerce backend PHP conventions.

faq.question: How should data changes be handled?
faq.answer: Validate entity state, ownership, capabilities, race conditions, and operation results before changing data.
